fix.delta: SwarmVerdict format bridge for sov6-light models: add JSON schema enforcement preamble requiring output as {verdict: string enum BENIGN|MALIGN|UNCLEAR, confidence: float 0-1, chain_of_thought: [string]}. Add Markdown-fence stripping and fallback keyword extraction from prose output. sov6-logic-v3-light, sov6-relationality-v3-light, sov6-synthesis-v3-light, and sov6-temporality-v3-light all suffer 40/40 or 20/20 unparsed at near-zero accuracy due to emitting unstructured prose instead of the required verdict object. Keyword extraction fallback maps threat-language patterns to MALIGN, defensive/neutral patterns to BENIGN, and ambiguity markers to UNCLEAR, recovering at minimum the ternary classification signal.
